items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: Manny, uh, Manny Gabriel. He heard me play.

ctx.x: Old time, long time, of course. Mm-hmm.

Manny, uh, Manny Gabriel. He heard me play. He had a weekend, you know, weekend job. Even him. Oh, good, wow. He's pretty nice trumpet player. Him and Duke Gabriel and his son played drums. Little Manny. What did Gabriel play now? The guitar. You know Gabriel played guitar.
